svg.title: Extractly offline evaluation architecture for CI/CD
svg.desc: An application retrieves raw documents from a Storage Account or any endpoint and an independent Golden Dataset from Azure Storage, repository JSON, or another store, calls Azure Content Understanding, and evaluates the returned extraction with Extractly. Built-in SchemaEvaluator and ExtractionEvaluator checks run alongside supplied custom or Foundry evaluators; Foundry graders require the Foundry runner. A separate runtime block selects LocalRunner on a local server or CI agent, or FoundryEvaluationRunner for Foundry SDK orchestration and optional publishing. Reports expose numbered quality metrics, support application-owned JSON and database persistence, and drive a threshold-based release gate. Foundry optionally receives precomputed document scores through the configured runner.
svg.text: Independent Golden Dataset + candidate extraction + measurable quality gates before release

Evaluation scoring is offline against gold. CU extraction and optional Foundry publishing are service calls. Applications own storage, authentication, and release policy.
